CommunityApplications.Profile:
Cruncharr is a self-hosted companion for organizing and maintaining your personal anime media library. It offers a clean, *arr-style web interface with catalog tracking, a release calendar, activity history, and Sonarr integration so it lines up with the collection you already manage. Multi-architecture image (amd64 and arm64).
This repository ships the Cruncharr container template. For documentation and support, visit the project page: https://github.com/mediavybz/Cruncharr
